title: Great start but became less of a Wow factor with each order.
text: Purchased them for my wife for Valentines Day 2022. The first order was Fantastic. However each order became less and less fantastic. Each month we discuss canceling but hold out for improvement. If the next order does not improve we are canceling. First few orders were worth the money. Now it is no better than we can purchase at the Grocery store. One more month.
label: neutral
